extracted.name: Best Cherry Cheesecake
extracted.description: This soft, no-bake recipe for the best cherry cheesecake is easy to prepare with the help of cream cheese, whipped topping mix, and cherry pie filling.
ingredient_lines: 2 (1.3 ounce) envelopes dry whipped topping mix (such as Dream Whip®)
instruction_lines: Combine crushed graham crackers and melted butter in a bowl; press mixture into a 9x11-inch baking dish.
Beat milk and whipped topping mix together in a bowl until fluffy.

Beat cream cheese and sugar together in a separate bowl until fully incorporated; stir into whipped topping mixture until smooth. Spread mixture onto graham cracker crust. Refrigerate until set, 1 to 2 hours. Top with cherry pie filling.
